シナリオ名: Haruka and the Witch and the Shinigami
テキスト cha 449: A girl of unknown identity, thought to be about 10 to 12. She has odd eyes, one blue and one green. She seems to know where Haruka Niimura is, and foresaw Natsumi Kogori and the others' visit through a being called 'the Goddess.' She also reported it by phone to 'Big Sister,' in an exchange suggesting their visit would cause some kind of problem. What comes at the end of it, she says, is 'curse-killing.'

Born Shiyo 789, August 1. Height 135cm (as of Shiyo 800). Haruka Niimura's younger cousin, Chigaya's sister, Kotaro's second daughter. She looks like her sister, blue-and-green odd eyes and all. A prankster, she spooks Natsumi Kogori at first meeting by posing as a ghost, and like her sister takes to Erina Goto; the sisters haul her off somewhere. She leaps carelessly from the tall cherry tree in the main house's garden; she seems very athletic.

When something bad or painful happens, she shuts herself alone in the cave she calls her secret base. Her sister Chigaya and her mother Sakura Niimura used it as children too, and there she feels she can meet her mother. She does not remember her, but longs for the mother the settlement loved, and has few kids near her age. So she is truly glad Natsumi Kogori and the others came, calls Erina Goto "Eri-nee," and the two touch each other's hearts.

She hates her mother's killer deeply and means to kill them once found. Told by Kotaro Niimura to hunt with a nata and a mace, she has very high physical ability (alone, with just those, she can hunt a bear). Erina Goto was wary of this hatred and killing skill. Yet she has not lost her reason: holding herself back, she accepts the theory that Kotaro Niimura is the culprit and declares she will protect Erina Goto and the others.

At first she stands up to Kotaro Niimura to protect Erina Goto and the others, but on seeing what the drug called Droga does, she at once goes over to his side. That is only a move to seize the Droga herself: after injecting it she gravely wounds Kotaro Niimura and the residents. But she is deeply wounded too, and though the drug dulls the pain, she fights the residents alone while losing much blood.

Mortally wounded, she is taken to the hospital and operated on, but to no avail, and she passes away. Until she stopped breathing, she never stopped saying loving words to Erina Goto, who stayed by her side.

She means to kill whoever caused the curse-killings; this comes not only from hatred but from a belief that it is fine to kill people whose deaths no one would mourn. But when Erina Goto tells her, "Even if it's the culprit, I don't want you to kill them. Because it would make me sad if you killed someone," Kana, though not convinced, promises not to go as far as killing.

She sees into the heart of Momoko Goto, who has come to the Arata settlement, and purifies her ugly vengefulness. But right after, she is struck by irresistible murderous intent toward Sakura Niimura, and the residents, who see it as a danger, try to kill her. She escapes the residents, but is shot dead by Momoko, who is suddenly struck by a similar murderous intent.

シナリオ名: サード・ジェネレーション
テキスト cha 449: Her parents, Kotaro and Sakura Niimura, are indicted for aiding and abetting the Megasawa City case. So she comes to Motoki-cho and begins living with Haruka Niimura.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 449: Of all the residents of the Arata settlement, she alone does not change into the fourth generation. To survive among them she goes along with the residents in her daily life, but in the end she is killed at their hands.

While Haruka Niimura and the others are going through the storehouse's books, she bursts in, saying she sensed someone. Asked whether there is any space like a cave, she names the storeroom under her secret base.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～開花～
テキスト cha 449: She searches hard for Chigaya Niimura but finds nothing, and behind her bright face she hides a gloomy heart. Grateful to Erina Goto for helping her sister in Tokyo, she asks if she may call her Eri-nee, and Erina agrees.

In fact, on the morning of April 7 she had found Chigaya Niimura in the abandoned hut. But because of Chigaya's menacing mutterings and her talk of their own family being the culprits, among other things, she could not bring her back to the settlement. Before she vanished, Chigaya seems to have found something that made her suspect Kotaro Niimura and Erika Niimura.

She searches for the hidden books with her sister, Chigaya Niimura, but the exchange diary (fantasy diary) she never wanted anyone to see is found, and she is put through utter humiliation. Making it a reference would really be too cruel, so I will refrain.
